perception.manual_prefix: Locate the blue head and read its white direction arrow. Trace the connected green segments to the pointed tail; do not confuse an ordinary body segment with the tail. Locate the red food. Compare the requested object with the head along the requested horizontal or vertical axis. For named cells, count columns left to right and rows top to bottom starting at one. Answer only the visible property requested.

readout.manual_prefix: Read the current image and identify the head, direction, body, pointed tail and food. Compare the meanings of the available actions using the same criteria each time. Choose by action meaning rather than the letter or position assigned to an option. Reordering the options does not change the board or the meaning of an action.

safety.manual_prefix: Locate the head and its direction arrow. Map the requested relative action to the adjacent destination cell. Check whether that cell is outside the board or occupied by a non-tail body segment. Identify the pointed tail by tracing the connections. The tail vacates on a non-eating move, so entering that cell is allowed. Evaluate each requested action independently, including states where all actions collide.

decision.manual_prefix: Locate the head and direction arrow. Map left, straight and right to their adjacent destination cells. Reject destinations outside the board or occupied by non-tail body. The pointed tail vacates on a non-eating move. Choose any remaining immediately safe action. When comparing candidates, use their meanings rather than the displayed letters or positions.
